name: selected-pills
summary: Teal key:value pills for a current selection inside a picker/multi-select trigger. Truncates to max-items, then a "+N" pill opens a popover listing the rest. Display-only (the home of the teal pills, read-only mode).

value.note: CSV ("a:1,b:2") or JSON array; or an Array set as a property.

max-items.note: How many pills to show before collapsing the rest into +N.

do: Use inside a picker/multi-select trigger to show the current selection as teal key:value pills.
Set max-items to control how many show before collapsing into a +N overflow pill.
dont: Don't use for an editable tag list — use Tags Input.
Don't rely on it for interaction; it is a display surface (the +N popover is the only affordance).

a11y.summary: Read-only display. Pills are not interactive; the only affordance is the +N popover, which must be keyboard-reachable and dismissible. Each pill reads as "key: value".
issues: The +N popover is hover/click-opened; ensure it is also keyboard-focusable in the product.

knownIssues: Display-only — for an editable selection use the Dropdown (multiple) or Tags Input.
changelog: 2026-08-12 — Catalogued in components/index.json (Tag family) so MCP search_components / get_component resolve it.
2026-06-29: added a full registry (Details / Usage / Accessibility / Known issues / Changelog) — it previously rendered from a manifest fallback with only Details.
decisionFlow: You don't pick this directly — it's the READ-ONLY display of chosen values INSIDE a DropdownPicker / multi-select trigger.
Need users to ADD/REMOVE free-text tags? -> LooseTags (input), not selected-pills.
Showing a status/severity, or a standalone labelled chip? -> Tag / Severity, not selected-pills.

variants.name: read-only-pills
variants.what: teal key:value pills for the current selection, display-only

variants.name: overflow-popover
variants.what: a '+N' pill that opens a popover listing the remaining selected values

sizes.name: default
sizes.note: single size; matches the picker trigger

read-only-pills.useWhen: showing the current multi-selection inside a picker/multi-select trigger (display-only)
read-only-pills.dontUse: letting users type/add tags (-> LooseTags); a standalone status chip (-> Tag/Severity)
read-only-pills.example: the chosen monitors/tags shown in a FlotoDropdownPicker trigger

overflow-popover.useWhen: the selection exceeds the trigger's max-items — collapse the rest behind a '+N' pill + popover
overflow-popover.dontUse: when all pills fit (show them inline)
overflow-popover.example: 'MySQL, PostgreSQL +3' in a multi-select filter value
